blocks.en: The adjoint boundary operators $C_j$ are generally not unique. However, it is clear from the last theorem that the space $N^*$ is uniquely determined. Hence different sets of adjoint boundary conditions are equivalent in the sense that they determine the same nullspace.
blocks.zh: 伴随边界算子 $C_j$ 一般不唯一. 然而, 由前一定理可知空间 $N^*$ 唯一确定. 因此, 不同的伴随边界条件组在确定同一零空间的意义下等价.
